name: tax is frozen at issuance; the statement adds up
notes: INV-14 (tax snapshot), INV-15 (due date from terms), INV-8 (statement shows payments, not applications). The billing math a controller will re-check by hand exactly once.
env: 8.75% default rate — determination is freedom, capture is contract

steps.notes: order totals are net — tax is a billing fact, not an ordering fact, because the rate belongs to the moment of issuance
INV-14: 8.75% snapshotted per line at issuance. If the rate changes tomorrow, this invoice never moves
short-paid and honestly so: the invoice stays open for the difference — resolved by credit note if justified, dunning if not, never fudged
the aging is net of nothing (INV-8): unapplied cash lives in its own view, so this number is what customers actually owe
balance-forward: opening + invoices − credits − payments = closing. The monthly document, minus the envelope
